615541.Description: [Activate Battle] Choose your Leader or up to 1 of your Battle Cards and it gets +25000 power for the battle. Then, if you have a Battle Card with 30000 power or more, add up to 1 Battle Card with a cost of 4 or less from your Drop to your hand.

615542.Description:
[When Attacking] If you have 7 or fewer cards in your hand, draw 1 card.

[When KO'd] Play this card from your Drop in Rest Mode. Then, you can't play "Zamasu : Fused" for the turn.

615544.Description:
[Permanent] All of your Battle Cards with a cost of 3 can't be removed from the Battle Area by your opponent's skills.

[End of Your Turn] Choose one —

• Play up to 1 Battle Card with a cost of 3 or less from your hand.

• Choose up to 1 of your opponent's Battle Cards with a cost of 3 or less and KO it.

615548.Description:
[Blocker] (After an opponent's attack, you may switch this card to Rest Mode and change the target of the attack to this card.)

[End of Your Turn] Switch this card to Active Mode.

666776.Description: [On Play] Choose all cards in the Battle Areas other than this card and place them at the bottom of their owner's deck in a random order.

666777.Description: [Activate Battle] Choose your Leader or up to 1 of your Battle Cards and it gets 25000 power for the battle. Then, if you have 6 or more energy, look at the top card of your deck and add it to your hand or add it to your energy in Rest Mode.
